test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"overcome."** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Overcome"** means to successfully deal with or defeat a problem or obstacle. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को पराजित या नियंत्रित कर लेना)
 
• The verb is often used with the preposition** "over"** to indicate the thing that is being overcome.
 
 
• **Example**: *She was able to **overcome**__ her fear of public speaking by practising and preparing thoroughly.*
